item.title: [HIGH] Fedora: fuse-overlayfs-1.17-1.fc44 (FEDORA-2026-4e0490640f)
item.description: Update to fuse-overlayfs 1.17 to fix CVE-2026-52791: privilege escalation via SUID/SGID bit preservation on file truncation.
